user.title: BRMesh via Home Assistant Bluetooth
user.description: Commands are broadcast from this Bluetooth adapter. Use the phone key from the BRMesh app if your lights are already set up there. Each mesh (phone key) is added as its own entry; several meshes can share one adapter.

error.invalid_key: Must be exactly 8 hex characters, e.g. A1A2A3A4.
error.key_in_use: Another BRMesh mesh already uses this phone key.

abort.already_configured: BRMesh is already set up. Add another mesh with Add entry.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a BRMesh light.
abort.bluez_unavailable: Could not reach BlueZ over D-Bus. This option needs Home Assistant running on Linux (Home Assistant OS, Supervised, or Docker with /run/dbus mounted).
abort.no_adapters: No local Bluetooth adapter that can advertise was found. Bluetooth proxies can't send commands.

data.use_local_adapter: Also send from this Home Assistant adapter

data_description.advertise_duration: How long each command is broadcast. Shorter is faster; raise it if lights miss commands.
data_description.advertise_interval: Shorter means more packets per command, so weak lights are more likely to receive it. Down to 20 ms works for connectable advertising (the default).
data_description.relay_scan: Sends scan requests with the forward bit, so lights near Home Assistant pass them on to lights out of range. Experimental.
data_description.transmitters: ESPHome actions ending in send_brmesh, from ESP32s running the brmesh_tx component (see brmesh-transmitter.yaml). Every command is sent through all selected transmitters at the same time.
data_description.use_local_adapter: Turn off to send only through the ESP32 transmitters.

add_device.title: Add a light manually
add_device.description: Use the values from a discovery log or an ESPHome fastcon light.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Each group is its own device under this mesh, with its lights under it. Pick a group to change or delete it, or start a new one.

group_edit.title: Group
group_edit.description: A light can be in only one group; selecting it here moves it out of its current group. Saving sends the changes to the lights, which must be in range. Each group becomes a light entity that switches all its lights with one command per light type, like the BRMesh app.

data_description.group_id: 1-255. Use the id of a group made in the BRMesh app to take it over (Flur is usually 1).
data_description.area: Puts the group's device into this area, so controlling the area switches the whole group with one command per light type. Keep the group's lights themselves out of this area, or the area also switches them one by one.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: Colour effects offered by every colour light, group and All lights. Pick one to change or delete it, start a new one, or add the BRMesh app's 21 built-in effects that are missing.

effect_edit.title: Effect
effect_edit.description: The light runs through the colours in order. Lights only show these 7 colours (each of red, green and blue on or off). A single colour alternates with off. Choosing a colour or white on a light ends its effect; switching off and on keeps it.
